text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and seven is hereby amended to read as
"Section 1. Any provisions of existing law to the contrary notwithstanding, the provincial officers of the
Provinces of Batanes, Mindoro, and Palawan, may, only until October sixteenth, nineteen hundred and
twenty-two, be paid the annual compensation fixed in previous laws, which shall in no case exceed the sums
hereinafter specified:
"In Batanes, the provincial governor, four thousand pesos; the provincial treasurer, three thousand pesos; the
provincial fiscal, three thousand pesos.
"In Mindoro, the provincial governor, four thousand five hundred pesos; the provincial treasurer, four
thousand five hundred pesos; the provincial fiscal, three thousand pesos.
"In Palawan, the provincial governor, four thousand eight hundred pesos; the provincial treasurer, four
thousand pesos; the provincial fiscal, three thousand pesos."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 8, 1922.
